message: The engine couldn't start: invalid x-api-key

problems.fix: The ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret is invalid or was revoked. Create a new key at https://platform.claude.com/settings/keys and update the secret in GitHub (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions).
problems.keyCheck: doesn't start with sk-ant-, so it isn't an Anthropic API key (maybe the key's name or ID was pasted instead of the key itself); length 31 characters (a full key is usually about 108)
